verdict.rationale: Stable is a SaaS virtual-mailbox and registered-agent service, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only a REST API with x-api-key auth, dashboard-configured webhooks and an llms.txt file, with no mention of an MCP server or endpoint. An API and llms.txt are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
